description: This file is a Markdown documentation describing the 'Composite Input HAL Interface' for a platform. It details the interface specifications, internal architecture, operational flow, and discovery mechanisms for managing analog composite video inputs via a HAL, including event handling, properties, metrics, and platform capabilities.

classes.name: ICompositeInputManager
classes.description: Manager interface for discovering and accessing composite input ports.

classes.name: ICompositeInputPort
classes.description: Interface representing a single composite input port, providing control and query capabilities.

classes.name: IPortEventListener
classes.description: Listener interface for receiving port-related events such as connection changes or signal status updates.

classes.name: PortCapabilities
classes.description: Capabilities of a specific port, including supported properties and metrics support.

classes.name: SignalStatus
classes.description: Enumeration of signal statuses (NO_SIGNAL, UNSTABLE, STABLE, NOT_SUPPORTED).

classes.name: VideoResolution
classes.description: Parcelable describing video resolution and format details.

classes.name: PropertyValue
classes.description: Union type representing property values of various data types.

classes.name: PropertyKVPair
classes.description: Key-value pair for batch property retrieval or setting.

classes.name: PortMetrics
classes.description: Telemetry metrics like lock time, signal drops, and uptime.

methods.name: getPortIds
methods.description: Retrieve list of available port IDs.

methods.name: getCapabilities
methods.description: Get the capabilities of a port.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Get a port interface by ID.

methods.name: getPortInfo
methods.description: Get descriptive info about a specific port.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Retrieve a property value by key.

methods.name: getMetrics
methods.description: Retrieve telemetry metrics for a port.

methods.name: setActive
methods.description: Activate or deactivate a port for video presentation.

methods.name: registerEventListener
methods.description: Register a callback for port events.
